title: Each type when guests arrive unannounced
caption:
Doorbell rings. Nobody called ahead. Sixteen types, sixteen reactions.

One has samosas in the freezer for exactly this moment. One vanished into the study. One produced biryani, kebabs and kheer in forty minutes. And one sensed it and already put the kettle on.

Tag the person who gets sent to the market every time.

What's your first move when guests show up?
